domains.label: Mail drafts
domains.explanation: Save a reply, a new mail or the follow-up nudge of a delegation as a draft in Gmail. A draft is never sent. You send it yourself.

domains.label: Mail labels and archive
domains.explanation: Add or remove labels, mark mail as read, and take mail out of the inbox. Nothing is deleted, and archived mail stays in All Mail.

domains.label: Calendar holds
domains.explanation: Put a block of time on your own calendar, with no guests. Nobody else gets an invitation.

domains.label: Calendar events with guests
domains.explanation: Create an event that invites other people. Google sends each guest an invitation in your name.
domains.fixedReason: An invitation goes to other people in your name, so you approve each one.

domains.label: Delegations
domains.explanation: Create, update and close the delegations on your desk, and set who each one waits on. This changes only the desk of the app. The nudge of a follow-up is a mail draft, in Mail drafts.

domains.label: Docs and notes
domains.explanation: Write a doc or a new version of one, and add a note about a person. This changes only the data of the app. A note written after the agent read mail or a page goes to a second model anyway.

domains.label: Browser form submits
domains.explanation: Send a form on a web page in the agent browser, for example a sign-up or a search form. A submit that looks like a purchase is in Purchases and always asks you. A page that the agent read makes each submit ask you anyway. A sub-agent never sends a form on its own.

domains.label: Unsubscribes
domains.explanation: Leave a mailing list with its unsubscribe link.
domains.fixedReason: An unsubscribe cannot be taken back, so it always waits for you.

domains.label: Code with network access
domains.explanation: Run code in the sandbox that can reach the web sites on its allow list. A page or a mail that the agent read makes each such run ask you anyway. A sub-agent never runs such code on its own.

domains.label: Purchases
domains.explanation: Pay for anything, in any way. A form submit in the agent browser counts as a purchase when its page, its button or any of its fields name an order, a payment, a booking, a ticket or a card, and so does a button that sends data with a script.
domains.fixedReason: Money leaves your account, so you approve each payment.

levelText.review: A second model checks each action and lets it through or holds it. You see every action in the activity and the trace.
levelText.auto: The agent acts on its own. You see every action in the activity and the trace.

domains.label: Mail drafts
domains.explanation: Save a reply, a new mail or the follow-up nudge of a delegation as a draft in Gmail. A draft is never sent. You send it yourself.

domains.label: Mail labels and archive
domains.explanation: Add or remove labels, mark mail as read, and take mail out of the inbox. Nothing is deleted, and archived mail stays in All Mail.

domains.label: Calendar holds
domains.explanation: Put a block of time on your own calendar, with no guests. Nobody else gets an invitation.

domains.label: Calendar events with guests
domains.explanation: Create an event that invites other people. Google sends each guest an invitation in your name.
domains.fixedReason: An invitation goes to other people in your name, so you approve each one.

domains.label: Delegations
domains.explanation: Create, update and close the delegations on your desk, and set who each one waits on. This changes only the desk of the app. The nudge of a follow-up is a mail draft, in Mail drafts.

domains.label: Docs and notes
domains.explanation: Write a doc or a new version of one, and add a note about a person. This changes only the data of the app. A note written after the agent read mail or a page goes to a second model anyway.

domains.label: Browser form submits
domains.explanation: Send a form on a web page in the agent browser, for example a sign-up or a search form. A submit that looks like a purchase is in Purchases and always asks you. A page that the agent read makes each submit ask you anyway. A sub-agent never sends a form on its own.

domains.label: Unsubscribes
domains.explanation: Leave a mailing list with its unsubscribe link.
domains.fixedReason: An unsubscribe cannot be taken back, so it always waits for you.

domains.label: Code with network access
domains.explanation: Run code in the sandbox that can reach the web sites on its allow list. A page or a mail that the agent read makes each such run ask you anyway. A sub-agent never runs such code on its own.

domains.label: Purchases
domains.explanation: Pay for anything, in any way. A form submit in the agent browser counts as a purchase when its page, its button or any of its fields name an order, a payment, a booking, a ticket or a card, and so does a button that sends data with a script.
domains.fixedReason: Money leaves your account, so you approve each payment.

levelText.auto: The agent acts on its own. You see every action in the activity and the trace.
